question: How do I set up the business: LLC, name, registrations?

nuggets.text: An LLC is formed by filing articles of organization with the SCC.
nuggets.quote: The articles of organization shall set forth:
For filing any one of the following, the fee shall be $100:

nuggets.text: The LLC pays an annual registration fee of $50.
Trading under an assumed name needs a certificate filed with the clerk of the Commission.
nuggets.quote: No person shall conduct or transact business in the Commonwealth under any assumed or fictitious name unless such person files in the office of the clerk of the Commission a certificate of assumed or fictitious name.

nuggets.text: The assumed-name certificate is on a form the Commission prescribes.
nuggets.quote: The certificate of assumed or fictitious name shall be on a form prescribed by the Commission that sets forth the following:

nuggets.text: The commissioner of the revenue issues no business licence until the assumed-name certificate is filed.
nuggets.quote: No license shall be issued by a commissioner of the revenue until a certificate of assumed or fictitious name has been made and filed (i) in the office of the clerk of the Commission

nuggets.text: A dealer registers with the Tax Commissioner or the local commissioner of the revenue before selling.
nuggets.quote: Every person desiring to engage in or conduct business as a dealer in this Commonwealth shall file with the Tax Commissioner or the local commissioner of the revenue, if the local commissioner elects to provide the services authorized under this section, an application for a certificate of registration for each place of business in this Commonwealth.

nuggets.text: An employer subject to the Workers' Compensation Act insures the payment of compensation.
nuggets.quote: Every employer subject to the compensation provisions of this title shall insure the payment of compensation to his employees in the manner hereinafter provided.
